items.resolution: Both claims checked against uv 0.13.5 source and a live scratch UV_TOOL_DIR on 2026-10-26: (1) create_environment deletes the tool dir including uv-receipt.toml, so a failed sync left rollback without a receipt; (2) the upgrade keeps the old receipt python, so moved tools were re-moved every run. Fixed in 210e674c (receipt restore before rollback, pyvenv.cfg minor check) with regression tests. The test_moves_customized_receipts_in_place follow-ups stay open.
items.issue: Eve VERIFY: uv tool upgrade --python receipt handling unverified against uv 0.13.5 upgrade_tool/create_environment behavior
items.detail: Eve VERIFY: (1) uv tool upgrade --python may delete the tool dir (receipt included) before syncing, so a failed sync leaves both rollback upgrades failing with a missing receipt; check uv 0.13.5 upgrade_tool/create_environment, then snapshot+restore the receipt if confirmed. (2) PRD unverified claim that the upgrade records the new interpreter in the receipt: run uv tool upgrade --python 3.14 huggingface-hub, check python = 3.14 in its receipt, second sysup must print all uv tools on python 3.14. Also open: add future=false receipts and a pinned customized case to test_moves_customized_receipts_in_place; fold test_accepts_plain_receipts_with_harmless_metadata into it.
